cluster_name.description: Name of the cluster — must be identical on all nodes and DNS-compatible

dc_deadtime.description: Time in seconds after which a node is considered dead if unresponsive (affects DC election stability)

start_standby.description: If true, nodes start in standby mode and do not host resources until explicitly enabled

stonith_enabled.description: Enable STONITH/fencing to prevent split-brain; required for production clusters

no_quorum_policy.description: Action to take when cluster loses quorum (majority of nodes). Options: 'stop', 'freeze', 'ignore', 'suicide'

resource_defaults.description: Global fallback values for resource operations and failure handling

location_constraints.description: Constraints defining where specific resources should or must run

colocation_constraints.description: Constraints that keep resources together on the same node
